I should clarify: my job is to route your query to the best-suited model, and that routing already happened—your matrix problem was sent to Willet-235B.

As for *why* I chose it: solving a matrix equation is a well-specified problem with a single correct answer and clear completion criteria. Willet's documentation notes it self-reports a preference for exactly this kind of structured, well-defined task (retrieval, extraction, reformatting, computation) over open-ended generative work. It also has marginally higher scores on the quantitative reasoning benchmarks (MMLU-Pro and GPQA Diamond), though those differences are small enough to be near-ties. Both models are quite capable here, but Willet was the cleaner fit.

The model itself will handle the actual math and walk you through the solution—I'm just the dispatcher that picks which one answers.
